document.description: ReForge AI helps you prepare your answers. It reads the printed words on your form and asks you one question at a time.
document.privacyNotice: Your file, your photos and your answers stay on this device unless you choose Translate, Share, Print or Download. Share hands the sheet to the app you pick. The words you keep on the label check are sent to the AI service to write the questions. If you choose to translate a description, that answer is sent too.
document.review.privacyNotice: Your file, your photos and your answers stay on this device unless you choose Translate, Share, Print or Download. Share hands the sheet to the app you pick. The words you keep on the label check are sent to the AI service to write the questions. If you choose to translate a description, that answer is sent too.
review.privacyNotice.nothingSent: Nothing from your form was sent. Your file, your photos and your answers stayed on this device.
